# sequence feature type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sequenceFeatureType`](gmeow-sequenceFeatureType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sequenceFeatureType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The kind(s) of a sequence feature (one or more [`gmeow:SequenceFeatureType`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeatureType.md) individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ (a feature classified as both 'gene' and 'pseudogene' by different sources) and must coexist as evidence ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
